summary: Muay Thai gym in central Bangkok (Japanese-language site) offering trial, long-term and private courses plus a student visa and Muay Thai program.

facts.label: Main session price
facts.value: 500 THB per session, Monday to Saturday 16:00 to 18:30

facts.label: Student visa program
facts.value: Long-stay program combining Muay Thai training with student visa support
facts.quote: ムエタイトレーニングと学生ビザサポートを組み合わせた長期滞在向けプログラムをご用意しています。

facts.label: Course lengths
facts.value: From a one-day trial to six-month and one-year courses
facts.quote: 一日体験から、半年、一年の長期コースも受け付けており
